name: hypnothera
description: Turn what your AI assistant knows about you into a personalized hypnosis session or multi-day journey on hypnothera.ai. Builds a short, anonymous brief you approve first — never sends chat logs.

interface.longDescription: Hypnothera turns what your assistant knows about your goals into a personalized guided hypnosis session or a multi-day journey, rendered as audio in the voice you choose. Search the free library of ready-made sessions, create your own for sleep, focus, confidence or mental rehearsal before a big day, and continue journeys day by day. The skill builds a short, anonymous brief you approve first and never sends chat logs. A wellness and self-improvement tool.
defaultPrompt: Make me a sleep session from what you know about me
Prep me for my interview with a hypnosis session
Turn my goals into a 7-day hypnosis journey
